title: Cancelling the confirmation saves nothing and keeps the picked status
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Active part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CONFCANCEL-01), with Sell Price $20.00, is stocked at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. On the Active tab, type {Part-A} in the search.
  2. Click the {Part-A} row.
  3. Change the Sell Price to 25.00.
  4. Click the Inactive option.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Click Cancel in "Deactivate part?".
  7. Click Cancel on Edit Inventory Part.
  8. Type {Part-A} in the search on the Active tab.
  9. Click the {Part-A} row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: the confirmation closes and the part window is back, with Inactive still selected and Sell Price still 25.00.
  • Step 8: {Part-A} is still on the Active tab.
  • Step 9: Sell Price reads $20.00 and Part Status shows Active: nothing was saved.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
